# Element Stairs & Railings

> Custom staircase and railing studio serving Fort Lauderdale, Broward County and South Florida. Design, fabrication and installation of custom stairs, stair remodeling, wood stairs, metal railings, glass railings and custom handrails for high-end homes.

## Company
- Name: Element Stairs & Railings
- Service area: Fort Lauderdale, Broward County, Miami-Dade, Palm Beach and greater South Florida
- Phone: (954) 826-5786 (Leonardo Haluche), (954) 588-4403 (Jader Alencar), (754) 326-3344 (office)
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/element.stairs
- Website: https://elementsstairs.lovable.app

## Services
- Custom Stairs — staircases designed for the architecture of each home, including floating and open-riser stairs.
- Stair Remodeling — replacing carpet, treads, risers and dated balustrades with new materials.
- Wood Stairs — white oak, walnut and other hardwood treads, skirts and refinishing.
- Metal Railings — fabricated and powder-coated steel balustrades, modern or traditional.
- Glass Railings — frameless low-iron tempered glass on stainless standoffs.
- Custom Handrails — hand-shaped continuous wood and metal handrails.

## Process
Consultation and site measurement, design and material selection, workshop fabrication, on-site installation and finishing.
